parsedVerdict.reasoning: The file is in the application layer. Its reserve method takes the parameter `request?: Request`, and Request is imported from the 'express' web framework. The rubric says an HTTP request type in an application method signature is a failure, even when the parameter is optional or unused. That is the case here: the parameter is optional and the method never reads it. The rest of the file fits the application role. The constructor injects SpotRepository, ReservationRepository and PaymentPort, which are all application ports. The method orchestrates domain objects (Reservation, spot.priceFor, clashesWith) and throws ParkingError, which comes from the domain. The candidate flag is confirmed.
